explication: SimpMusic is a Compose Multiplatform YouTube Music client for Android and desktop. Users browse or search music, choose tracks or playlists, and play them with background playback; lyrics, audio effects, and offline support extend that experience. Separate capabilities include library and playlist management, listening analytics and recaps, and social or service integrations. The graph combines README-documented capabilities with the sampled entry-point, platform, and integration source; unsampled implementation wiring is shown only where the tree or README supports the subsystem, not as a verified call chain.
